title: Feature flags: edit registry.go only, regenerate toggles_gen.*
answers: How do I add a new feature flag in Grafana?
Why do toggles_gen.go, toggles_gen.json and toggles_gen.csv all change for one flag?
Can I hand-edit toggles_gen.go to add a flag?
What files need to stay in sync when adding a feature toggle?
body: Feature flags are defined in a single source-of-truth list in pkg/services/featuremgmt/registry.go (the `FeatureFlag` struct literal with Name/Description/Stage/Owner/Expression/RequiresRestart/Generate). Adding or changing an entry there and running the generator produces matching updates in toggles_gen.go (FlagX constant), toggles_gen.json, and toggles_gen.csv. These three generated files must never be hand-edited directly — they must always match what registry.go would generate, or codegen checks fail. `Generate: {Go: true}` controls whether a Go constant is emitted; `RequiresRestart: true` is reflected into all three outputs.
applies: Any change adding/modifying entries in pkg/services/featuremgmt/registry.go and the generated toggles_gen.* files
says: I edited the generated toggles file but my changes were overwritten

search: Feature flags are defined in a single source of truth: pkg/services/featuremgmt/registry.go, where FeatureFlag struct literals contain Name, Description, Stage, Owner, Expression, RequiresRestart, and Generate fields. Running the code generator produces toggles_gen.go (FlagX constants), toggles_gen.json, and toggles_gen.csv; these three generated files must never be hand-edited directly or codegen validation fails. The Generate: {Go: true} field controls whether a Go constant is emitted; RequiresRestart: true affects all three generated outputs. Applies to any addition or modification of feature flag entries in registry.go and regeneration of the three toggles_gen.* files.
